beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Four entrances: a standard spring where damping is the personality, an overshoot spring that squashes on landing, a draw-on stroke that traces the path before the fill floods in, and a mask reveal. An entrance is a first impression — pick one and commit; four entrances is no entrance.
Your turn. Paste this: animate my logo's entrance with a Remotion spring — show me damping five, twenty, and eighty side by side. Three numbers, three personalities.
Musinique, in motion. Part one. Liam, in for Bear.
